name: Wo de Guan Yinping Na you Zhemeyi Shi
original_name: 我的關銀屏哪有這麼易死
source: Liu Bei's army faced a heavy defeat in the fire assault on multiple camps by the Eastern Wu army. Guan Yu's daughter, Guan Yinping, also perished in the chaos and violence of the battle. With the death of his soulmate, the crestfallen Zhao Guang discovered a way to rewrite and alter the course of history, but, the key of it lies in the hands of a mysterious woman...
